items.title: Jack Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 24, 1997
items.q: I must have been seventeen otherwise my mother wouldn’t have allowed me to be in Sylvan Beach I guess you know.

ctx.x: So do you remember how old you were when you had this first experience in Sylvan Beach with this band?
I would say seventeen — sixteen, seventeen. I must have been seventeen otherwise my mother wouldn’t have allowed me to be in Sylvan Beach I guess you know.
So you came home and said: guess what I did, I played with this band.
